description:
Make an earlier version's content the file's content again, as its
    owner or a collaborator. The restore is a new version and the content it
    replaces is kept, so a restore can be undone the same way; restoring the
    current content changes nothing (``changed`` false). The size limits
    are ``colony_write_project_file``'s. Answers the file's new ``version``
    and ``etag``.

expected_etag.description: Optimistic-concurrency guard (= If-Match), as on colony_write_project_file: the etag colony_get_project_file answered for the CURRENT file. When given, the restore is refused with PRECONDITION_FAILED if the file changed since.
expected_etag.title: Expected Etag

filename.description: The file's name within the project, e.g. index.html or app.js.
filename.title: Filename

number.description: The version's number, as colony_list_project_file_versions lists it.
number.title: Number

name: colony_restore_project_file_version
